en: Artist files: after the interface language was changed, the biography could stay in the old language. It now comes in the new one (the file says it is looking the artist up meanwhile), and an artist.txt you edit is read again after a restart.
zh: 艺术家档案：切换界面语言后，简介可能一直停留在原来的语言；现在会改用新语言（获取期间显示正在查询），修改过的 artist.txt 在重启后也会重新读取。
